purpose: Prevent post-hoc conversion of EHT variability into an astrophysical Mpemba claim and define the minimum observational design for any future test.

existing_public_data_scope.reason: The outcomes were public before this protocol lock. The available epochs do not by themselves identify two matched relaxation trajectories toward one common equilibrium/attractor.
allowed_claims: bounded statements about published horizon-scale variability and polarimetric evolution when sourced to the EHT paper/data
tests of ingestion, custody, preprocessing and statistical machinery
falsification of an attempted Mpemba interpretation when required trajectory conditions are absent
forbidden_claims: prospectively preregistered detection on already published outcomes
astrophysical Mpemba detection from sparse epoch ordering alone

required_data_properties: two or more physically comparable relaxation trajectories
same declared target or stationary attractor under a justified matching regime
time cadence sufficient to resolve crossing and first-passage ordering
a holdout or genuinely future release when feasible
future_candidate_design.state_vector_rule: Use only observables present in both trajectories with a declared physical/statistical interpretation. The final vector and ordering must be frozen before the candidate crossing is inspected.

distance_primary_family.name: covariance_whitened_distance
distance_primary_family.definition: D(x,mu)^2 = (x-mu)^T C^{-1} (x-mu) / k for k frozen observables when a valid covariance C exists
distance_primary_family.fallback: If C is unavailable or singular, no primary covariance-aware Mpemba decision is allowed; a diagonal or pseudoinverse substitution requires a separately preregistered robustness analysis and cannot silently replace the primary test.
monotone_robustness_family: normalized Euclidean distance on the same frozen observable vector
componentwise standardized L1 distance on the same frozen observable vector

future_candidate_design.target_rule: The equilibrium/stationary target must be physically justified and frozen independently of the later crossing; it may not be chosen because it maximizes the claimed effect.
future_candidate_design.far_near_rule: At t0, the far trajectory must have D_far(0) > D_near(0). This ordering is determined before any later crossing test.
future_candidate_design.crossing_rule: A crossing requires a time interval after t0 in which D_far becomes strictly less than D_near under the primary distance and remains so for the preregistered persistence criterion.
future_candidate_design.first_passage_rule: tau(epsilon) is the first time at which D <= epsilon and the trajectory satisfies the preregistered persistence criterion. epsilon is dataset-specific but must be frozen before outcome inspection and justified from the measurement/noise scale rather than tuned to create a crossing.
future_candidate_design.uncertainty_rule: Propagate the declared covariance/calibration uncertainty through D, crossing time and tau(epsilon); report posterior/bootstrap/ensemble uncertainty according to the frozen data model.
null_family_required: stochastic/turbulent variability under standard accretion physics
ordinary monotone relaxation without slow-mode suppression
future_candidate_design.multiplicity_rule: One primary observable vector, distance and epsilon rule is locked. Any additional observable/distance/epoch scan is secondary and requires declared multiplicity control.
future_candidate_design.holdout_rule: A holdout epoch/release may not be used to tune preprocessing, target, distance, epsilon, null family or matching before final evaluation.
future_candidate_design.independent_replication_rule: Internal CI and same-author reruns are reproducibility only. Promotion requires an independent operator or repository to reproduce from clean checkout and frozen inputs.

promotion_checklist: official bytes and file-level SHA256 verified
observable vector frozen before crossing inspection

current_decision.reason: The current public product is a valid strong-gravity observational source but does not by itself satisfy the operational design required for a direct astrophysical Mpemba or Hawking-thermometry claim.
